_comment: Pinning the version makes CI results comparable across OSes and across time.
It does NOT make behaviour identical: build configuration and the set of
enabled codecs still differ between the Linux and Windows builds. Treat this
as 'comparability improved', never as 'same version = same behaviour'.
'archives.sha256' is verified right after download, before extraction.
'binaries.sha256' is verified after extraction AND on every cache restore,
so the check does not depend on where the bytes came from.
Bump 'cache_generation' to invalidate every cache entry without changing any
pinned value (e.g. after a poisoned-cache warning). Changing anything in this
file already changes the cache key, because the key embeds this file's SHA-256.
To change the pinned version, see 'SHA-256 refresh' in README.md next to this
